name: gdm
description: GDM is a system service that is responsible for providing graphical logins and managing local and remote displays.
post_install: id -u gdm >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -c "GDM Daemon Owner" -d /var/lib/gdm -u 21 -g gdm -s /bin/false gdm
su gdm -s /bin/bash -c "dbus-run-session gsettings set org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power sleep-inactive-ac-type nothing"
